basic_details.job_title: TISS Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 3 Research Officer, Research Interns Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS), Tuljapur Off-Campus, is filling 3 contract positions under the project "Impact Assessment Study of i-RISE (Inculcating Rural India Skill Enhancement)": 1 Research Officer at a consolidated Rs.60,000 per month for three months, and 2 Research Interns at a consolidated Rs.15,000 per month for two months. Applications go through a Google Form (https://forms.gle/kszrqxQePc43vKNG8) up to 05:00 PM on 03 December 2026, and the online interview is on 04 December 2026 at 02:30 PM.

age_limit.details: Post Age Limit Research Officer Preferably below 45 years Research Interns Preferably below 35 years | The notice does not print a date for counting age or any category-wise age relaxation. It states that the Institute reserves the right to relax the age requirement for persons already holding comparable positions at a University/research institution of repute, and to relax candidates' qualifications based on work experience.

how_to_apply: Submit the application online through the Google Form link given in the advertisement: https://forms.gle/kszrqxQePc43vKNG8.
Give your email ID in the Google Application Form.
Upload a scanned copy of the application form (Annexure-1) and a copy of the updated resume in a SINGLE PDF file only, at the last tab of the Google Form.
Submit before the last date: 03 December 2026, up to 05:00 PM. Applications received through any other mode will not be considered.
Only shortlisted candidates e-mail a copy of all the educational documents in a SINGLE PDF file only to [email protected] and/or [email protected].

Annexure-1 application form (asks for the post applied for, name, address, mobile number, date of birth, nationality, category details, examinations passed, previous employment, languages known and a declaration) with an updated resume, in one PDF
Copies of marksheet and certificate of degree courses
Work experience certificate, if experience is stated in the application
At the time of joining: self-attested PHOTOCOPIES of the relevant certificates of educational qualifications, work experience and ID proof, along with the original documents for verification

rows.details: Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS), Tuljapur Off-Campus
Impact Assessment Study of i-RISE (Inculcating Rural India Skill Enhancement)
Research Officer: three months; Research Interns: two months (positions on contract)
Research Officer Rs.60,000 per month; Research Interns Rs.15,000 per month (consolidated)
TISS Tuljapur Off-Campus; field visits to selected districts

content_sections.heading: About TISS
content_sections.text: The notice describes the Tata Institute of Social Sciences as a centrally funded public university, declared an Institution Deemed to be University under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956, and a Grant-in-Aid Institute under the Ministry of Education, Govt. of India. It has four campuses, in Mumbai and Tuljapur (Maharashtra), Guwahati (Assam) and Hyderabad (Telangana), and undertakes education, training, research and outreach activities across several states in India. The Tuljapur Off-Campus is at Apsinga Road, Post – Tuljapur, District – Dharashiv, PIN code – 413 601 (landline +91 9270105222/23-26; website www.tiss.ac.in ).

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The total is 3 positions. The notice does not print a category-wise break-up.

rows.pay: Consolidated payment of Rs.15,000/ per month

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice does not print a date for counting age or any category-wise age relaxation. It states that the Institute reserves the right to relax the age requirement for persons already holding comparable positions at a University/research institution of repute, and to relax candidates' qualifications based on work experience. Research Officer: good written and oral communication skills in Marathi, Hindi and English. Preference will be given to candidates with experience and proficiency in Hindi/English, particularly in writing project reports. Research Interns: good written and oral communication skills in Hindi, Marathi and English. Preference will be given to candidates with experience and proficiency in Hindi and English, particularly in writing project reports. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: M.Sc./MA/ M.Phil./PhD; experience in projects having Agriculture /Rural Development; good knowledge of basic statistical techniques and statistical software like STATA/SPSS/R
Bachelor's degree in Social Work / Social Sciences/Agriculture / MA; good knowledge of data entry in statistical software

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Research Officer: consolidated payment of Rs.60,000/-per month + Traveling + Food and accommodation as per Institute norms and within the approved project budget. Duration: three months. Research Interns: consolidated payment of Rs.15,000/ per month + Traveling expenses during data collection as per Institute norms and within the approved project budget. Duration: two months. Both positions are to be filled on contract. The notice does not mention HRA or other allowances.

content_sections.heading: TISS Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Designing tools for data Collections/Questionnaire/FGD Engage/Facilitate data collection through a field survey/focus Group Discussion/Case studies/Secondary sources Field visits to the selected districts from different states Basic Analysis, tabulation and interpretation of large surveys Report writing and documentation of data Identification of key informants from various stakeholders and conduct of qualitative and quantitative interviews To help the Project Leader for preparation of initial draft report Data collection through a field survey/focus group Group Discussion/Case studies/Secondary sources Field visits to all selected Districts in selected states Identification of key informants from various stakeholders and conduct of qualitative interviews and focus group discussions

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TISS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Annexure-1 application form (asks for the post applied for, name, address, mobile number, date of birth, nationality, category details, examinations passed, previous employment, languages known and a declaration) with an updated resume, in one PDF Scheduled Caste/Tribe/OBC/PwD certificate, if applicable Copies of marksheet and certificate of degree courses Work experience certificate, if experience is stated in the application At the time of joining: self-attested PHOTOCOPIES of the relevant certificates of educational qualifications, work experience and ID proof, along with the original documents for verification

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be informed over e-mail to appear for the online personal interview. The interview will be conducted online on 04 December 2026 at 02:30 PM. The Institute reserves the right to invite persons for interview who may not have applied as per the above procedure, and not to fill up the vacancy advertised. The notice does not describe how marks or shortlisting are decided.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in TISS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 positions: 1 Research Officer and 2 Research Interns, all on contract under the i-RISE impact assessment project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the TISS Research Officer and Research Intern posts?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting online applications is 03 December 2026, up to 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Research Officer at TISS?
faq.answer: The notice lists M.Sc./MA/ M.Phil./PhD, with M.Phil./PhD candidates preferred. It also asks for experience in projects having Agriculture/Rural Development and good knowledge of basic statistical techniques and software such as STATA/SPSS/R.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Research Interns at TISS?
faq.answer: The notice lists a Bachelor's degree in Social Work / Social Sciences/Agriculture / MA, with preference for Masters in Social Work/Rural Development/Sociology/Economics/Agriculture. Good knowledge of data entry in statistical software is also listed.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for TISS Research Officer and Research Intern?
faq.answer: The Research Officer age limit is preferably below 45 years, and for Research Interns it is preferably below 35 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the TISS i-RISE project posts?
faq.answer: The Research Officer gets a consolidated Rs.60,000 per month plus traveling, food and accommodation as per Institute norms. Research Interns get a consolidated Rs.15,000 per month plus traveling expenses during data collection, both within the approved project budget.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for TISS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply through the Google Form at https://forms.gle/kszrqxQePc43vKNG8 and upload the Annexure-1 application form and an updated resume as a single PDF at the last tab. Applications received through any other mode will not be considered.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected for the TISS project positions?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates are informed by e-mail to appear for an online personal interview, held on 04 December 2026 at 02:30 PM. Originals of documents are verified at the time of joining.

faq.question: Q9. How long is the TISS Research Officer and Research Intern contract?
faq.answer: The Research Officer position runs for three months and the Research Intern positions for two months. Both are on contract.

faq.question: Q10. Is TA/DA paid for the TISS interview, and is an NOC needed?
faq.answer: No TA/DA is payable for appearing for the interview. A candidate under employment must bring a No Objection Certificate from the employer to appear for the interview.
